scope: Independent static review of current M03 UI/API/central wiring, not a browser reproduction or live media acceptance.

findings.issue: Interrupted video uploads cannot resume across page reload, and cached signed URLs are reused on retry.
findings.effect: React-only state loses the stable session/intents after reload; an expired signed URL cannot be renewed from the retry control. This misses the M03 interrupt/reload/resume acceptance path.
findings.remedy: Persist a bounded actor/workspace upload manifest without URLs/headers/tokens/file bytes; reselect and checksum-match files, retrieve the existing session to renew its scoped URL, and replay its completion intent.

findings.issue: A supported video whose File.type is empty is declared video/mp4.
findings.effect: A valid MKV/WebM is reserved with the wrong declared MIME and fails the native magic/type check even though the picker offers that format.
findings.remedy: Resolve a supported declared MIME using the known filename extension when the browser omits MIME; native content validation must remain authoritative.

findings.issue: Disabling candidate uploads also removes the adapter used for existing Ready playback and frame reads.
findings.effect: With uploads flag false, profile RPC reads work but candidate playback returns unavailable and frame content cannot select its adapter.
findings.remedy: Provide independent candidateRead wiring like logoRead/specsRead, with upload mutations disabled and Ready read authorization preserved.

findings.issue: Older filter requests may overwrite newer library search results.
findings.effect: Debouncing cancels only the pending timer, not an already-started request; a slow old response can replace the current filtered result set and cursor.
findings.remedy: Cancel obsolete requests and/or bind updates to a current request generation and filter fingerprint.

findings.issue: The error retry reload bypasses the dirty-card guard used by the header reload.
findings.effect: If a card has unsaved choices and the server row version changed, retrying a list error replaces its version-keyed card and discards those choices.
findings.remedy: Route every full-list reload through the same dirty-state gate, while allowing append-only pagination.
